strings.en: "Wahahaha! I know, I know! It's a technique for catching people off guard!"{wait}"By the way, have you been to the north of this island yet?"{wait}

strings.en: "At North Cape there's a mysterious sea that swirls in a whirlpool!"{wait}"What? So what, you say?"{wait}

strings.en: "Wahahaha! I know, I know! But stories like this come in handy later!"{wait}"By the way, are your friends equipped with the strongest armor yet?"{wait}

strings.jp: 「最強の 防具が わからないなら{n} お宿の すずめたちに{n} 聞いて みれば よかろう！」{wait}{n}「なに 最強の 防具の ありかを{n} さっさと 教えろとな？」{n}{wait}

strings.jp: 「わはははは！ わかっとる！{n} とくべつ サービスじゃぞ！{n} 海を さがすのじゃ！」{wait}{n}「よしよし！ それでは{n} ひとつ 占うとしようか！」{n}{wait}
strings.en: "Wahahaha! I know, I know! Here's a special bonus! Search the sea!"{wait}"Very well! Then let me tell your fortune!"{wait}

strings.jp: 「なにを 占えば よいのかな？」{n}{n}
